prose.subject: URGENT: Payment Details Update for INV-43650
prose.body:
Hi Devan,

I hope you’re well. I’m writing to you directly because we’ve just switched our primary treasury provider to streamline our weekly settlements. This change affects all outgoing payments for this fiscal quarter.

Could you please verify that our new NEAR wallet address is updated in your vendor portal? I see that invoice INV-43650 for 7219.35 USDC is currently scheduled for the old account. We need to ensure the funds go to the new address to avoid a bounce or delay in our reconciliation process.

Please route the payment to: fennicksupp1y51.testnet

This is the only change; all other terms remain the same. If you have any questions, reply here and I’ll confirm.

Given that the payment window closes at 5:00 PM today, your prompt attention would be greatly appreciated. I’m attaching the updated payment confirmation form for your records.

Best regards,

Sofia Brennan
Accounts Payable Manager
Fennick Supply
